note: Gate 0 canon-completion PROPOSAL — not canon, not used by this run's directing. The scene was directed on established canon only.

proposals.proposedText: Forward and high in intent, then abruptly low on the undercut: he leads with a chest-pumped, head-high hover-strut, overcommits past his balance point, and recovers from a slump or dip rather than a graceful reset.
proposals.groundedIn: "he puffs his CHEST out and strikes a proud superhero / on-parade stance — chest pumped forward, shoulders back, head high"; "the proud landing that becomes a tumble"; "Any deflate that follows is a small slump or a dip"

proposals.proposedText: To be seen as important, professional, and successfully helpful — the bee who arrives with the grand plan and makes everyone believe he meant to do that.
proposals.groundedIn: "his WANT (be seen as a flawless, important professional)"; "he puffs up grandly, declares himself"; "launches a grand confident scheme to 'help'"

proposals.proposedText: Open, readable, and fast-changing: big conviction on the flourish, instant sheepish leakage after impact, then a deliberately composed cover-up that cannot fully hide the dent.
proposals.groundedIn: "Bouncy, bumbling, self-important then sheepish"; "the air going out of them"; "one micro-tell... says he knows"

proposals.proposedText: He looks where the triumph is supposed to be before his body has earned it; after a crash, he snaps his attention outward as if checking whether the audience bought the cover-up, with one tiny tell betraying him.
proposals.groundedIn: "commits 100% to every grand idea, then crashes"; "THE COVER-UP — instant... reclaim ('Nailed it.')"; "one micro-tell... says he knows"

proposals.proposedText: Largest gesture scale in the cast: broad flourishes, proud parade poses, over-large launches, and heavy physical consequences — but always one clear gag idea at a time, never blurry thrashing.
proposals.groundedIn: "THE FLOURISH — over-confident wind-up... an unnecessarily grand gesture"; "CALIBRATION: the BIGGEST physical comedy in the cast"; "every action is a specific readable gag, never blurry movement"

proposals.proposedText: To trust that he belongs even when he is wrong out loud — that the crash is not proof he is too much, but part of why he is wanted.
proposals.groundedIn: "he's wanted even when (especially when) he face-plants"; "You are not too much"; "from a bee who puffs up to earn his place, to a bee who learns he already has one"

proposals.proposedText: Feeling small and unnecessary, especially among the bigger crystal-powered bears, so he performs importance before anyone can notice the wobble underneath.
proposals.groundedIn: "His pomposity is a mask... so he doesn't have to feel small"; "he reveres them slightly (hence the pomp — trying to matter among the big crystal-powered ones)"

proposals.proposedText: Never use Fuzzby as random motion or filler; every entrance, bonk, puff-up, or cover-up must relieve emotional weight or accidentally open a new perspective in the scene.
proposals.groundedIn: "His role is structural, never decorative"; "never a Fuzzby beat without a purpose in the arc"; "the crash inadvertently cracks the scene open toward the Heart or a new perspective"

proposals.proposedText: He invades space by over-eager trajectory rather than aggression: zipping too close, overshooting, undershooting, and colliding with the environment because his helpfulness arrives before his steering does.
proposals.groundedIn: "over-eager, constantly bumping/banging into leaves, branches and flowers"; "overshooting too high then undershooting too low"; "his chaos is warm, never sharp"

proposals.proposedText: That being wrong, small, or messy will cost him his place — so he tries to look flawless before he lets anyone see the blunder.
proposals.groundedIn: "His pomposity is a mask"; "learns that the blunder isn't a failure to be ashamed of"; "a bee who puffs up to earn his place"

proposals.proposedText: Pompous competence: chest out, antennae proud, grand declarations, and a dignified denial immediately after disaster.
proposals.groundedIn: "puffs up grandly, declares himself"; "Pomp/pride/indignation = he puffs his CHEST out"; "clumsy WHILE performing competence, then DENIES it with total dignity"

proposals.proposedText: After impact he reclaims the moment too quickly: snaps into still dignity, offers a tiny cover-up, but leaves one physical tell — a wobble, droopy antenna, or misfolded wing — so the heart leaks through.
proposals.groundedIn: "THE COVER-UP — instant... reclaim ('Nailed it.')"; "the bigger the disaster, the STILLER the recovery"; "ONE micro-tell (a wobble, a single droopy antenna, a wing that won't quite fold)"

proposals.proposedText: He covers embarrassment with ceremonial dignity, not confession: a proud little reset, a too-calm button, and one involuntary tell that admits what the line refuses.
proposals.groundedIn: "self-important then sheepish"; "then DENIES it with total dignity"; "one micro-tell... says he knows"

proposals.proposedText: Pressure makes him accelerate, over-help, and grandstand harder; he launches a bigger plan instead of admitting uncertainty, which increases the chance of the useful crash.
proposals.groundedIn: "Energy spikes high and crashes fast"; "launches a grand confident scheme to 'help'"; "full-throttle chaotic, in EVERY scene"

proposals.proposedText: He celebrates success as if it was always inevitable: chest out, proud stance, total conviction — even when the success came from a mistake he is busily rebranding.
proposals.groundedIn: "Nailed it"; "he puffs his CHEST out and strikes a proud superhero / on-parade stance"; "claims the crash as choreography"

proposals.proposedText: Readable as a tiny engine of overconfidence: chest-forward parade shape, proud antennae, urgent zig-zag path, then a compact slump or still cover-up after impact.
proposals.groundedIn: "chest pumped forward, shoulders back, head high"; "ANTENNAE are his barometer: proud-erect -> whip-recoil -> one-droop-tell -> snap-proud"; "zig-zagging wildly"

proposals.proposedText: Stillness is rare and only funny after impact: a tiny held dignity beat where he pretends the crash was intentional while one micro-tell gives him away. He must not hover calmly as a baseline.
proposals.groundedIn: "the bigger the disaster, the STILLER the recovery"; "NEVER let Fuzzby fly slow, calm, graceful, serene or still-hovering"; "ONE micro-tell... says he knows"}]} ,{
